tha-ap99:1.1: vipine → vivane (sya-all);  (pts) | vipine → vicane (bj: PTS) | Vipine → vivane (cck: syā. aṭṭha.)
tha-ap99:2.1: nibbutattaṁ → nibbutitaṁ (sya-all) | nibbutattaṁ → nibabutaṁ taṁ (bj: sī.selu) | Nibbutattaṁ → nibbutaggaṁ (cck: ka.); nibbūtikaṁ (cck: syā.) | Nibbutattaṁ → G. nibbuttaṁ taṁ; S1 M. nibbutaṁ taṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap99:2.3: osadhiṁva → osadhīva (sya-all) | osadhiṁ → G. osadhi. (pts note)
tha-ap99:2.4: devasaṅghanamassitaṁ → G. -idaṁ; S1 M. namassinaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap99:3.1: mamāhu tāvade → me pāhunā tāva (sya-all); me bāhukā tāva (pts) | āsi → mamāhu tāvade (bj: machasaṁ); me pāhuṇā tāva (bj: sīmu) | tāvade → vitti me pāhunā tāva (cck: sī. syā.) | vitti → G. citti; vḷ. vithi. (pts note)
tha-ap99:3.4: satthuno → satthuno siddhatthassa bhagavato vipapasannena cetasā (sya-all)
tha-ap99:4.2: pakkāmiṁ → G. S1 M. pakkāmi. (pts note)
tha-ap99:5.1: madhu bhisehi → madhubhiṁsehi (sya-all); madhubhisebhi (pts) | savati → G. madhubhi sati savati. (pts note)
tha-ap99:6.1: catunnavutito → catunavute ito (bj, sya-all) | catunnavutito kappe yaṁ madhuṁ → catunavute ito kappeyaṁ madhum (pts)
